name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Algae goes with either Beacon or Luna (but not both).

Fontaine, Venus, and Fungus belong to different colonists.
Fontaine goes with at least one of Cortex, Titan, or Venus.
Fontaine, Titan, and Algae belong to different colonists.
